module_title: Boilermaker Tools, Equipment, Machines and Materials
title: Trade-Related Tools and Equipment
objective: Recognise common categories of boilermaker tools and equipment and the importance of correct identification and condition.
safety_boundary: Recognition only; no instructions for operating hazardous tools or equipment.

sections.heading: 1. Tool categories
sections.body: Boilermaking uses different categories of tools and equipment for measuring, marking, holding, forming, assembly and other controlled tasks.

sections.heading: 2. Correct identification
sections.body: The correct tool or equipment must be identified from the job requirement and authorised workplace information.

sections.heading: 3. Condition matters
sections.body: Damaged, unsuitable or uncertain equipment must not simply be used. Its condition must be dealt with under workplace controls.

sections.heading: 4. Competence boundary
sections.body: Recognising equipment is different from being trained and authorised to operate it.

questions.question: Are different tools used for different task purposes?
Should damaged equipment simply be used?
Does recognition equal authorisation to operate equipment?
